title: APIGen-MT: Agentic Pipeline for Multi-Turn Data Generation via Simulated Agent-Human Interplay
authors_zh: Akshara Prabhakar、Zuxin Liu、Ming Zhu、Jianguo Zhang、Tulika Manoj Awalgaonkar、Shiyu Wang、Zhiwei Liu、Haolin Chen、Thai Hoang、Juan Carlos Niebles、Shelby Heinecke、Weiran Yao、Huan Wang、Silvio Savarese、Caiming Xiong
paper_type_zh: 多轮工具调用轨迹数据发布与构造配方
best_for_zh: 研究环境型 agent trajectory、模拟用户、成功筛选、SFT 数据构造与发布审计的读者
one_line: APIGen-MT releases 5,000 success-filtered Retail/Airline tool-use dialogues from a blueprint-and-simulation pipeline, but omits failed runs, replay state, verifier logs, and the complete xLAM training mixture.
APIGen-MT 发布 gated 的 5,000 条 Retail/Airline 成功轨迹，用蓝图验证与模拟交互构造 SFT 数据，但未公开失败运行、重放状态、验证日志或完整 xLAM 训练混合。
why: It connects API schemas, policies, latent environment state, mixed validation, simulated users, and assistant-token behavioral cloning in one auditable construction chain, while showing why a conversation-only success subset cannot by itself reproduce the environment or establish unrestricted training reuse.
inclusion_reason: APIGen-MT exposes an important environment-to-training-data recipe: sampled API/policy context becomes a validated task blueprint, then a simulated human-agent tool episode, and finally a success-filtered SFT trajectory subset. Its release also makes success-only selection, mixed-verifier dependence, incomplete lineage, and non-replayability concrete audit targets.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The archival source is the NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track paper, with arXiv:2504.03601 v4 as a separately versioned preprint and the official APIGen-MT project and Hugging Face pages as artifact records. The paper addresses a concrete gap in tool-use data: single-turn function-calling examples do not capture a user who reveals information incrementally, an agent that alternates between replies and API calls, or a mutable environment whose final state decides whether the whole interaction succeeded.

For its Retail and Airline case study, APIGen-MT treats interaction as a POMDP over user input, latent environment state, agent actions, observations, transitions, and reward. The construction object begins as a task blueprint containing a user intent, ordered ground-truth actions, expected outputs, state changes, and validation results. Phase 2 turns a validated blueprint into a simulated human-agent-environment episode and keeps it only when final state effects and response outputs agree with the blueprint. This is a full-episode mixed feedback contract, not merely a syntactic function-call check.

The public object is narrower than the construction object. Salesforce/APIGen-MT-5k is a gated, CC-BY-NC-4.0 release of 5,000 success-filtered rows in one train split and one 128 MB JSON file. A row exposes conversations, system, and tools: human messages, structured function_call messages, tool observation results, assistant text, a policy prompt, and tool schemas. It does not expose the blueprint, ground-truth actions or outputs, initial/reset or final state, state diff, reward, verifier votes or logs, attempt ID, terminal reason, or replay manifest.

This work belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because its trainable record is an ordered state-action-observation-style tool-use transcript and its acceptance predicate depends on an executable environment. The adjacent boundary is important: it does not release a version-pinned environment package, failed-trajectory corpus, preference pairs, process labels, reward-model targets, or an RL-ready replay interface. Its paper-demonstrated training use is assistant-token behavioral cloning, represented here only as sft and agent_training.

The atlas value is the auditable chain from API/policy context to blueprint, mixed validation, simulated interaction, success filtering, and an SFT subset. The official citation and public data artifact are verified, but the accepted metadata remains L3_summary_ready because code, immutable environment/version binding, row-level lineage, replay metadata, complete mixture information, decontamination, and license reconciliation remain unresolved.

归档来源是 NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track 正式论文；arXiv:2504.03601 v4 是单独版本化的预印本，官方 APIGen-MT 项目页与 Hugging Face 页面则用于核验工件。论文解决的是工具使用数据中的具体缺口：单轮 function-calling 样本无法表示用户逐步透露信息、agent 在回复与 API 调用间切换，以及由可变 environment 的最终状态决定整段交互是否成功。

在 Retail 和 Airline 案例中，APIGen-MT 把交互形式化为包含用户输入、潜在 environment state、agent action、observation、transition 与 reward 的 POMDP。构造对象首先是任务蓝图，其中含用户意图、有序 ground-truth action、预期输出、状态变化和验证结果。Phase 2 再把已验证蓝图转换为模拟 human-agent-environment episode；只有最终状态效果与回复输出都和蓝图一致时才保留。这里的反馈契约是 full-episode mixed verification，而不只是函数调用语法检查。

公开对象比构造对象窄。Salesforce/APIGen-MT-5k 是 gated、采用 CC-BY-NC-4.0 的 5,000 条成功筛选数据，只包含一个 train split 和一个 128 MB JSON 文件。每行公开 conversations、system 与 tools：human message、结构化 function_call message、工具 observation 结果、assistant 文本、policy prompt 和 tool schema。它没有公开蓝图、ground-truth action/output、初始/reset 或最终 state、state diff、reward、verifier vote/log、attempt ID、terminal reason 或 replay manifest。

该工作属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为可训练记录是有序的 state-action-observation 风格工具交互 transcript，接收判据又依赖可执行 environment。相邻边界必须明确：它没有发布版本固定的 environment package、失败轨迹语料、preference pair、process label、reward-model target 或 RL-ready replay interface。论文实际展示的训练方式是 assistant-token behavioral cloning，因此本卡只标注 sft 和 agent_training。

对 atlas 的价值在于把 API/policy context、任务蓝图、混合验证、模拟交互、成功筛选和 SFT 子集连成可审计链条。正式引用和公开数据工件已经核验，但 accepted metadata 仍保持 L3_summary_ready，因为代码、不可变 environment/version 绑定、逐行 lineage、replay metadata、完整训练混合、decontamination 与 license 协调仍未解决。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The one-sentence contribution is a two-phase recipe that first constructs and validates an executable multi-action task blueprint, then realizes it as a simulated multi-turn human-agent-tool episode and retains only successful episodes for behavioral cloning.

Phase 1 builds a dependency graph over APIs, samples paths and context from executable Retail/Airline APIs, domain policy and data, PersonaHub personas, and examples, and generates a blueprint with intent q, ground-truth actions a_gt, and expected outputs o_gt. Validation combines JSON/format checks, executable checks of API names, arguments, and types, state diff_patch, policy tests compiled to Python unit tests, and an LLM committee scoring Correctness, Completeness, Satisfaction, and Creativity. Failed proposals can be revised from summarized feedback; reverse task recombination joins validated actions and outputs into longer tasks and revalidates policy and semantics.

Phase 2 separates three actors: a simulated LLM human incrementally reveals the intent, GPT-4o operates as the function-calling test agent, and the executable tau-bench-derived environment supplies tool results and latent state transitions. The simulated user uses Best-of-N self-critique with N=4. Each task is attempted up to three times; all unique successes are aggregated, while failed Phase-2 trajectories are discarded.

The feedback contract has distinct scopes. Format, execution, and policy checks reject malformed or disallowed blueprints; an LLM committee judges semantic task quality; the environment and expected-output matcher produce binary full-episode success r=1. These systems can observe serialized calls, policy-test behavior, expected outputs, and final state effects. They cannot establish that every accepted conversation is natural, that committee judgments are calibrated, or that intermediate reasoning is correct. The released 5k rows omit all verifier outputs and reward fields, so the construction signal cannot be reconstructed from the public transcript alone.

The key distinction from APIGen-style single-turn function-calling generation is the validated blueprint-to-dialogue conversion under a simulated user and mutable environment. It should be read alongside tau2-bench-2025 for the neighboring agent-evaluation and terminal-predicate problem and magnet-tool-use-2025 for adjacent multi-turn tool-use data. APIGen-MT's specific role is a success-filtered training-data recipe and partial release, not a new replayable benchmark environment.

一句话贡献是：APIGen-MT 先构造并验证可执行的多 action 任务蓝图，再把它实现为模拟的多轮 human-agent-tool episode，最后仅保留成功 episode 用于 behavioral cloning。

Phase 1 在 API 上建立依赖图，从可执行 Retail/Airline API、domain policy/data、PersonaHub persona 与示例中采样路径和 context，并生成包含意图 q、ground-truth action a_gt 与预期输出 o_gt 的蓝图。验证结合 JSON/格式检查、API 名称/参数/类型的可执行检查、state diff_patch、转换为 Python unit test 的 policy test，以及由 LLM committee 对 Correctness、Completeness、Satisfaction、Creativity 的评分。失败提案可依据汇总反馈迭代修订；reverse task recombination 会拼接已验证的 action/output 形成更长任务，并重新检查 policy 与语义。

Phase 2 分离三类 actor：模拟 LLM human 逐步透露意图，GPT-4o 以 function-calling test agent 身份执行任务，tau-bench 衍生的可执行 environment 提供工具结果与潜在 state transition。模拟用户采用 N=4 的 Best-of-N self-critique。每个任务最多尝试三次，所有唯一成功运行会被聚合，而失败的 Phase-2 轨迹会被丢弃。

反馈契约包含不同作用范围。格式、执行和 policy 检查淘汰畸形或不合规蓝图；LLM committee 判断任务语义质量；environment 与 expected-output matcher 产生二元 full-episode success r=1。这些系统能观察序列化调用、policy-test 行为、预期输出和最终状态效果，却不能证明每个接收对话都自然、committee judgment 已校准或中间推理正确。公开 5k 行缺少全部 verifier output 和 reward 字段，因此无法仅从 transcript 重建构造阶段的监督信号。

相较 APIGen 风格的单轮 function-calling 生成，关键变化是通过模拟用户与可变 environment，把已验证蓝图转换为对话。可把 tau2-bench-2025 作为相邻的 agent evaluation/terminal-predicate 阅读对象，把 magnet-tool-use-2025 作为相邻的多轮 tool-use data 阅读对象。APIGen-MT 的特定角色是成功筛选训练数据的构造配方与部分发布，而不是新的可重放 benchmark environment。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs combine tau-bench-derived Retail and Airline Python-function APIs, domain policies and records, API metadata, PersonaHub personas, and few-shot examples. The API graph links A to B when B can consume A's output and policy permits their co-occurrence. Random walks choose multi-API contexts; write APIs anchor ground-truth actions. The paper says the final proceedings setup has 5 read and 13 write APIs, while the current project page says 15 read and 13 write APIs. These are versioned-source differences, not counts that should be merged.

Phase 1 generates a task blueprint with model thought, user intent, ordered ground-truth actions, expected outputs, and a state diff. It then applies format/JSON validation, executable API-name/argument/type checks, policy tests expressed as Python unit tests, and LLM-committee rubric scoring with majority voting. Above-threshold tasks are accepted; failures receive summarized feedback for iterative refinement. The committee membership, model versions, numeric threshold, temperatures, seeds, and exact sampling distribution are unknown. Reverse task recombination concatenates validated actions and outputs, synthesizes a combined intent, and reruns policy and semantic validation.

Phase 2 rolls out the blueprint with an LLM user, GPT-4o in function-calling mode, and the executable environment. The user simulator chooses among four candidate replies with self-critique. A task can receive up to three trajectory attempts. Interaction stops when the user concludes—the appendix prompt uses ###STOP###—or when a predefined turn limit is reached. A run is retained only if its final environment-state effects agree with ground-truth actions and its assistant responses agree with expected outputs. All unique successes are kept; failed Phase-2 runs are discarded. Exact response matching, turn limits, endpoint revisions, decoding settings, and per-row actor lineage are undisclosed.

For training, each retained trajectory is split at every assistant response. Prompt and non-assistant tokens are masked, so the loss predicts assistant text and function calls. Reported filtered behavioral cloning uses LLaMA-Factory, full fine-tuning, DeepSpeed ZeRO-3, FlashAttention 2, bfloat16, AdamW, at most three epochs, and one NVIDIA H200 node over Llama 3.1/3.2 Instruct and Qwen 2.5 Instruct bases. APIGen-MT trajectories are mixed with APIGen function-calling data and other xLAM/ActionStudio agentic data; exact counts, weights, deduplication, and checkpoint-specific mappings are unknown. This supports SFT/agent behavioral cloning, not preference learning, reward-model training, process supervision, or RL.

The public output is Salesforce/APIGen-MT-5k: 5,000 rows, one train split, one apigen-mt_5k.json file, and no public failed split. It is explicitly a subset of xLAM-2 training data. Appendix B scales APIGen-MT samples as high as 8k in experiments, and final xLAM models use additional datasets; therefore the gated 5k file is neither the largest experimental condition nor the complete xLAM mixture.

Reproduction should freeze the dataset card at commit abc4a517d67c541f85f6470cbd8fd3186b36830e, the data file at commit 8f8a1d2fb8f871fc5221a0200dd3d329d01a6b53, and apigen-mt_5k.json at SHA-256 5225b54198c1d4d2ae9ff14ddd98341751677138efe64ded10dcb770276b5841. The release still cannot replay construction because it lacks blueprint/ground truth, reset/final state, state diff, reward, verifier/committee logs, attempt and terminal metadata, an environment revision, and a replay manifest. The HF card's “Code” link targets apigen-mt.github.io, whose checked contents are HTML/CSS/JS project-site source; no APIGen-MT generation or validation implementation was verified, so artifacts.code remains null.

输入包括 tau-bench 衍生的 Retail/Airline Python-function API、domain policy/record、API metadata、PersonaHub persona 和 few-shot example。当 B 可消费 A 的输出且 policy 允许二者共同出现时，API graph 建立 A 到 B 的边；random walk 选择多 API context，write API 则锚定 ground-truth action。最终 proceedings 论文写的是 5 个 read API 和 13 个 write API，而当前项目页写的是 15 个 read API 和 13 个 write API。两者是不同版本来源的差异，不能静默合并成同一计数。

Phase 1 生成包含 model thought、user intent、有序 ground-truth action、expected output 和 state diff 的任务蓝图；随后执行格式/JSON 验证、API 名称/参数/类型的可执行检查、以 Python unit test 表达的 policy test，以及 LLM committee rubric scoring 与 majority voting。分数高于阈值的任务被接收，失败任务则获得汇总反馈并迭代修订。committee 成员、模型版本、数值阈值、temperature、seed 和精确采样分布均为 unknown。reverse task recombination 会拼接已验证 action/output、合成组合意图，并重新运行 policy 与语义验证。

Phase 2 使用 LLM user、function-calling 模式的 GPT-4o 和可执行 environment 对蓝图进行 rollout。user simulator 通过 self-critique 从四个候选回复中选择一个；每个任务最多有三次 trajectory attempt。交互在用户结束时停止——appendix prompt 使用 ###STOP###——或达到预设 turn limit 时停止。只有最终 environment-state effect 与 ground-truth action 一致、assistant response 与 expected output 一致的运行才保留。所有唯一成功运行会被保留，失败的 Phase-2 运行会被丢弃。精确 response matcher、turn limit、endpoint revision、解码设置和逐行 actor lineage 均未披露。

训练时，每条保留轨迹会在每个 assistant response 处分割；prompt 与非 assistant token 被 mask，因此 loss 只预测 assistant 文本和 function call。论文报告的 filtered behavioral cloning 使用 LLaMA-Factory、full fine-tuning、DeepSpeed ZeRO-3、FlashAttention 2、bfloat16、AdamW、最多三轮 epoch 和一台 NVIDIA H200 节点，base 包括 Llama 3.1/3.2 Instruct 与 Qwen 2.5 Instruct。APIGen-MT 轨迹还与 APIGen function-calling data 及其他 xLAM/ActionStudio agentic data 混合；精确数量、权重、deduplication 和 checkpoint-specific mapping 为 unknown。因此证据只支持 SFT/agent behavioral cloning，不支持 preference learning、reward-model training、process supervision 或 RL。

公开输出是 Salesforce/APIGen-MT-5k：5,000 行、一个 train split、一个 apigen-mt_5k.json 文件，没有公开失败 split。官方明确称它只是 xLAM-2 训练数据的一个子集。Appendix B 的实验把 APIGen-MT 样本扩展到最高 8k，最终 xLAM 模型还使用其他数据集；所以 gated 5k 文件既不是最大实验条件，也不是完整 xLAM 训练混合。

复现时应把 dataset card 固定到 commit abc4a517d67c541f85f6470cbd8fd3186b36830e，data file 固定到 commit 8f8a1d2fb8f871fc5221a0200dd3d329d01a6b53，并把 apigen-mt_5k.json 固定到 SHA-256 5225b54198c1d4d2ae9ff14ddd98341751677138efe64ded10dcb770276b5841。即使如此，发布仍无法重放构造过程，因为缺少 blueprint/ground truth、reset/final state、state diff、reward、verifier/committee log、attempt/terminal metadata、environment revision 与 replay manifest。HF card 的“Code”链接指向 apigen-mt.github.io；已检查内容实际是 HTML/CSS/JS 项目站源码，未验证到 APIGen-MT 生成或验证实现，因此 artifacts.code 保持 null。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Collection evidence is reported under the paper's own models and tau-bench-derived setup. Table 1 reports 70% Phase-1 task-generation success versus 28% without agentic feedback, 67% Phase-2 simulation success, trajectories ranging from 1 to 29 turns, and averages of 7 tool calls and 6 user turns. These statistics support the claim that iterative validation and simulated interaction produced accepted episodes; they do not measure false-positive verifier rates or public-release completeness.

The paper's human audit sampled 200 trajectories. Table 2 reports 99.4% query clarity, 70.2% sufficient information, 77.4% achievability, 0% fatal error, 0.75% erroneous step, 0% self-correction, and 99% completion. Appendix C.1 says professional experts inspect query properties, plans, responses, tool calls, errors, and completion. The sampling procedure, number and qualifications of annotators, inter-annotator agreement, and adjudication are not disclosed, so these percentages are author-reported audit evidence rather than independently calibrated labels.

Historical model results show that the whole training recipe can produce competitive tool-use models. On the BFCL leaderboard snapshot dated 2025-04-03, Table 3 reports xLAM-2-70b-fc-r at 78.19 overall and 75.12 multi-turn, xLAM-2-8b-fc-r at 72.83 overall and 69.25 multi-turn, and GPT-4o FC at 41.0 multi-turn. On tau-bench with at least five trials, default naive user, think tool only, and no prompt optimization, Table 4 reports xLAM-2-70b-fc-r at 67.1 Retail, 45.2 Airline, and 56.2 overall, compared with GPT-4o at 52.9 overall and Claude 3.5 Sonnet (new) at 60.1 overall. These are historical benchmark results under stated conditions, not proof that the public 5k subset alone caused the gains.

The trajectory-length ablation is more directly tied to APIGen-MT construction. With the trajectory count held fixed, removing reverse-recombination data reduces Airline from 45% to 33% and Retail from 64% to 61% (Figure 3). This supports the paper's claim that longer, recombined trajectories contribute useful diversity in these two domains; it does not establish the mechanism outside the tested environments.

Mixture evidence limits attribution. Table 5 reports a Qwen-32B Retail+Airline behavioral-cloning condition at BFCL 65.0 versus a 57.8 base, while the full xLAM mixture reaches 75.8. Appendix A.2 says APIGen-MT is trained jointly with APIGen and other xLAM/ActionStudio data, and Appendix B studies APIGen-MT scales up to 8k. Therefore neither the final xLAM scores nor the 8k ablation can be attributed to the gated 5k public subset without the missing mixture and sample-mapping records.

Artifact inspection verifies a different class of evidence: the HF card declares 5,000 English rows, gated access, CC-BY-NC-4.0, one train split, and the ShareGPT-like fields; the file pointer fixes the checked JSON hash. It also verifies that construction-only blueprints, ground truth, state diffs, rewards, verification logs, failures, reset state, and replay metadata are absent. Benchmark performance does not repair those release gaps or prove data quality.

收集证据建立在论文自身使用的模型与 tau-bench 衍生设置上。Table 1 报告 Phase-1 任务生成成功率为 70%，去掉 agentic feedback 后为 28%；Phase-2 模拟成功率为 67%；轨迹长度为 1–29 turn，平均包含 7 次 tool call 和 6 次 user turn。这些统计支持“迭代验证与模拟交互能够产生被接收 episode”的主张，但没有测量 verifier false-positive rate 或公开发布完整性。

论文的人类审计抽样了 200 条轨迹。Table 2 报告 query clarity 99.4%、sufficient information 70.2%、achievability 77.4%、fatal error 0%、erroneous step 0.75%、self-correction 0%、completion 99%。Appendix C.1 说明 professional expert 会检查 query 属性、plan、response、tool call、error 与 completion。sampling procedure、annotator 数量和资格、inter-annotator agreement 与 adjudication 均未披露，因此这些百分比是作者报告的 audit evidence，而不是独立校准后的标签。

历史模型结果表明完整训练配方可以产生有竞争力的工具使用模型。在日期为 2025-04-03 的 BFCL leaderboard snapshot 上，Table 3 报告 xLAM-2-70b-fc-r overall 78.19、multi-turn 75.12，xLAM-2-8b-fc-r overall 72.83、multi-turn 69.25，GPT-4o FC multi-turn 41.0。在至少五次 trial、default naive user、仅使用 think tool 且无 prompt optimization 的 tau-bench 条件下，Table 4 报告 xLAM-2-70b-fc-r 的 Retail 为 67.1、Airline 为 45.2、overall 为 56.2；GPT-4o overall 为 52.9，Claude 3.5 Sonnet (new) overall 为 60.1。这些是带明确条件的历史 benchmark result，不能证明公开 5k 子集单独造成了增益。

trajectory-length ablation 与 APIGen-MT 构造的联系更直接。在轨迹数量固定时，移除 reverse-recombination data 会使 Airline 从 45% 降到 33%，Retail 从 64% 降到 61%（Figure 3）。这支持更长的 recombined trajectory 在两个已测 domain 中提供有效多样性的主张，但不能把机制外推到其他 environment。

mixture evidence 限制了归因。Table 5 报告 Qwen-32B 的 Retail+Airline behavioral-cloning 条件在 BFCL 上为 65.0，base 为 57.8，而完整 xLAM mixture 达到 75.8。Appendix A.2 说明 APIGen-MT 会与 APIGen 和其他 xLAM/ActionStudio data 联合训练，Appendix B 还研究了最高 8k 的 APIGen-MT 规模。因此，在缺少 mixture 和 sample mapping 记录时，既不能把最终 xLAM 分数归因于 gated 5k 公开子集，也不能把 8k ablation 当成 5k release 的结果。

工件检查验证的是另一类证据：HF card 声明 5,000 条英文记录、gated access、CC-BY-NC-4.0、一个 train split 和 ShareGPT-like 字段；file pointer 固定了已检查 JSON 的 hash。检查也确认 construction-only 的 blueprint、ground truth、state diff、reward、verification log、failure、reset state 与 replay metadata 均未公开。benchmark performance 不能弥补这些发布缺口，也不能证明数据质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is API and function-calling data built around isolated user requests and target calls. Such records can teach tool schema adherence but do not naturally represent incremental disclosure, clarification, multi-step state changes, or recovery across a dialogue. APIGen already supplies related function-calling data; tau-bench supplies executable Retail/Airline tasks and policies. APIGen-MT does not invent those components.

The concrete change is to make a validated task blueprint the bridge between environment specification and conversation. The blueprint records intent, ordered ground-truth actions, expected outputs, and state effects before a user simulator and test agent realize the task. Programmatic execution/policy checks and LLM committee judgments refine this object; reverse task recombination expands multi-action complexity; a final state/output predicate selects successful episodes. This separates task correctness from surface dialogue generation more explicitly than directly prompting for a transcript.

The data object also changes from an isolated function call to an episode with human messages, assistant text, function calls, observations, policy context, and tool schemas. The feedback attaches both to blueprint fields and to the full episode. However, the released 5k object exposes only the transcript-side fields, so the novelty of the construction contract is not preserved as reusable per-row supervision.

What is not new includes API dependency graphs, LLM-generated synthetic data, majority-vote model judging, Best-of-N sampling, self-critique, executable environments, behavioral cloning, or tau-bench itself. The contribution is their integration into a blueprint-to-simulation pipeline and the reported use of reverse recombination and state/output success for multi-turn data selection. It does not establish a new RL algorithm, reward model, preference interface, process verifier, or openly replayable environment.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is that environment-grounded agent training data needs two schemas: a rich construction/audit record and a compact model-facing transcript. APIGen-MT shows the value of the former in the paper and releases only the latter in 5k form. Reuse therefore requires checking the missing blueprint-to-row lineage, failed attempts, verifier calibration, environment pin, mixture mapping, and license constraints rather than treating scale or model scores as sufficient quality signals.

Version drift is itself part of the novelty audit. The final proceedings report 5 read and 13 write APIs, whereas the current project page reports 15 read and 13 write APIs. The public release contains 5k rows, while experiments reach 8k and final models use a broader mixture. These differences should remain explicit evidence boundaries, not be harmonized into a cleaner but unsupported story.

既有基线是围绕单个用户请求与目标调用构造的 API/function-calling data。这类记录可以训练 tool schema adherence，却难以自然表示逐步信息披露、澄清、多步状态变化和对话中的恢复。APIGen 已提供相关 function-calling data，tau-bench 提供可执行 Retail/Airline 任务与 policy；APIGen-MT 并没有发明这些组件。

具体变化是把已验证任务蓝图作为 environment specification 与 conversation 之间的桥梁。在 user simulator 和 test agent 实现任务之前，蓝图先记录 intent、有序 ground-truth action、expected output 与 state effect。programmatic execution/policy check 和 LLM committee judgment 会修订这一对象；reverse task recombination 扩大多 action 复杂度；最终 state/output predicate 选择成功 episode。相较直接提示模型生成 transcript，这一流程更明确地区分了任务正确性和表面对话生成。

数据对象也从单个 function call 变为包含 human message、assistant text、function call、observation、policy context 和 tool schema 的 episode。反馈同时附着在 blueprint field 与完整 episode 上。然而，公开 5k 对象只暴露 transcript 侧字段，因此构造契约的新意没有作为可复用的逐行 supervision 被保留。

非新内容包括 API dependency graph、LLM 生成的 synthetic data、majority-vote model judging、Best-of-N sampling、self-critique、executable environment、behavioral cloning 与 tau-bench 本身。贡献在于把这些组件整合为 blueprint-to-simulation pipeline，并使用 reverse recombination 与 state/output success 进行多轮数据筛选。它没有建立新的 RL algorithm、reward model、preference interface、process verifier 或开放可重放 environment。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向信号是 environment-grounded agent training data 需要两套 schema：丰富的 construction/audit record，以及紧凑的 model-facing transcript。APIGen-MT 在论文中展示前者的价值，却只以 5k 形式公开后者。因此复用前必须检查缺失的 blueprint-to-row lineage、失败尝试、verifier calibration、environment pin、mixture mapping 与 license constraint，不能把规模或模型分数当成充分的质量信号。

版本漂移本身也是 novelty audit 的一部分。最终 proceedings 报告 5 个 read API 与 13 个 write API，当前项目页则报告 15 个 read API 与 13 个 write API；公开发布有 5k 行，实验最高达到 8k，最终模型又使用更广的 mixture。这些差异必须保留为显式证据边界，不能为了叙事整洁而强行统一。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The public release is a success-only transcript subset, not the construction corpus. Phase 2 attempts each task up to three times, aggregates unique successes, and explicitly discards failures. APIGen-MT-5k therefore hides invalid calls, near misses, unsuccessful recovery, rejection reasons, and the true attempt distribution. Its single train split offers no development/test partition, split seed, task-family grouping, or mapping to private paper-era data.

Replay is blocked by missing environment and lineage fields. Public rows lack the task blueprint, ground-truth actions and outputs, initial/reset and final state, state diff, reward, validator and committee logs, attempt ID, seed, terminal reason, exact API/policy/database revision, and executable replay manifest. A visible conversation can be consumed by SFT, but it cannot independently rerun the terminal predicate or establish which construction checks accepted that row.

The verifier stack has unmeasured error modes. Format and type checks do not establish semantic correctness. Python policy tests can be incomplete or wrong. Final-state and response matchers can produce false positives or false negatives, yet their implementation and adversarial evaluation are not released. LLM committee scores and majority voting can share correlated model or prompt bias; committee identities, calibration, threshold, and per-row votes are unknown. Best-of-N self-critique may select judge-preferred rather than human-realistic user behavior.

Generator and training attribution remain incomplete. GPT-4o and DeepSeek-V3 are used across generation, validation, and interplay, but exact dated endpoints, stage assignments, prompts beyond representative appendix examples, temperatures, seeds, retries, and per-row model lineage are unknown. The final xLAM models mix APIGen-MT with APIGen and other xLAM/ActionStudio data. Public 5k, experimental scale up to 8k, and checkpoint-specific mixtures are not mapped to one another, so model gains cannot be attributed to the public file.

Version and code evidence are insufficient for reconstruction. The final paper and current project page disagree on the read-API count. The dataset has no verified tag or named release, so mutable main must be replaced by fixed card/file commits and the checked SHA-256. The HF “Code” target is an HTML/CSS/JS project-site repository, not verified synthesis, validation, filtering, training, or evaluation code. The related xLAM repository is a living multi-project repository and says data are only partially released; it is not a frozen APIGen-MT implementation.

Reuse rights require more than reading the SPDX-style label. Access is gated and the card declares CC-BY-NC-4.0, while also stating that GPT-4-generated portions must not be used to develop models competing with OpenAI. Per-row restricted provenance, tau-bench and PersonaHub rights, model-provider output terms, and coverage of upstream components are unresolved. Synthetic generation and the authors' statement that no sensitive personal information was collected reduce some risks but do not replace a per-record PII, consent, or source-rights audit.

No dedicated deduplication, semantic-overlap, or benchmark-contamination audit was verified. Construction and tau-bench evaluation reuse the same Retail/Airline API and policy substrate, and BFCL instance-level overlap is unreported. The 200-trajectory human audit lacks disclosed sampler, annotator count, agreement, and adjudication. These limitations support partial status and conditional SFT reading, not claims of an unrestricted, decontaminated, replayable, or RL-ready release.

公开发布是 success-only transcript 子集，而不是完整构造语料。Phase 2 对每个任务最多尝试三次，聚合所有唯一成功运行，并明确丢弃失败运行。因此 APIGen-MT-5k 隐藏了 invalid call、near miss、失败恢复、拒绝原因和真实 attempt 分布。单一 train split 也没有 development/test partition、split seed、task-family grouping 或与论文时期私有数据的映射。

缺失 environment 与 lineage 字段阻止 replay。公开行不含任务 blueprint、ground-truth action/output、initial/reset 与 final state、state diff、reward、validator/committee log、attempt ID、seed、terminal reason、精确 API/policy/database revision 和 executable replay manifest。可见 conversation 可以被 SFT 消费，但不能独立重跑 terminal predicate，也不能确认是哪一项构造检查接收了该行。

verifier stack 存在未测量的错误模式。格式和类型检查不能建立语义正确性；Python policy test 可能不完整或本身有误；final-state/response matcher 可能产生 false positive 或 false negative，但实现和 adversarial evaluation 均未公开。LLM committee score 与 majority voting 可能共享相关的模型或 prompt bias；committee 身份、calibration、threshold 与逐行 vote 为 unknown。Best-of-N self-critique 也可能选择 judge 偏好的用户行为，而不是更像真实人的行为。

generator 与训练归因仍不完整。GPT-4o 和 DeepSeek-V3 被用于 generation、validation 与 interplay，但精确 dated endpoint、阶段分工、除 appendix 示例外的 prompt、temperature、seed、retry 与逐行 model lineage 均为 unknown。最终 xLAM 模型把 APIGen-MT 与 APIGen 及其他 xLAM/ActionStudio data 混合；公开 5k、最高 8k 实验规模与 checkpoint-specific mixture 之间没有映射，因此不能把模型增益归因于公开文件。

版本与代码证据不足以重建流程。最终论文与当前项目页的 read-API 数量不一致；dataset 没有已验证 tag 或 named release，所以必须用固定的 card/file commit 和已检查 SHA-256 替代可变 main。HF 的“Code”目标是 HTML/CSS/JS 项目站仓库，不是已验证的 synthesis、validation、filtering、training 或 evaluation 代码。相关 xLAM 仓库是持续变化的多项目仓库，并声明数据只部分发布；它不是冻结的 APIGen-MT 实现。

复用权利不能只看 SPDX 风格标签。访问是 gated，card 声明 CC-BY-NC-4.0，同时又说明 GPT-4 生成部分不得用于开发与 OpenAI 竞争的模型。逐行受限 provenance、tau-bench/PersonaHub 权利、模型提供商输出条款及上游组件是否被覆盖仍未解决。synthetic generation 与作者关于未收集敏感个人信息的声明可以降低部分风险，但不能替代逐记录 PII、consent 或 source-rights audit。

未验证到专门的 deduplication、semantic-overlap 或 benchmark-contamination audit。构造与 tau-bench evaluation 复用相同的 Retail/Airline API/policy substrate，BFCL 的 instance-level overlap 也未报告。200 条轨迹的人类审计缺少 sampler、annotator 数量、agreement 与 adjudication 披露。这些局限支持 partial 状态和有条件的 SFT 阅读，不支持“无限制、已去污染、可重放或 RL-ready 发布”的主张。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within environment_agent_trajectory_data, APIGen-MT is useful first as a construction blueprint. A builder can separate environment context sampling, blueprint generation, executable and judgment validation, reverse recombination, simulated-user rollout, terminal state/output checking, success-only filtering, and model-facing serialization. That decomposition makes it easier to identify which modules need independent tests and which metadata must survive into a release.

For SFT and agent behavioral cloning, the gated 5k file provides multi-turn examples with policy context, tool schemas, human messages, calls, observations, and assistant replies. Reuse is conditional: a team must accept gated access, review CC-BY-NC-4.0 plus the additional GPT-4 competition restriction and upstream rights, freeze the two HF commits and file hash, inspect the row schema, and keep the single-train-split and success-only provenance visible. The paper does not show that 5k alone reproduces any xLAM checkpoint.

For verifier design, the paper offers a layered checklist: syntax and type checks for calls, executable environment checks, policy unit tests, LLM rubric judgments, and a full-episode state/output predicate. A follow-up should publish each layer's output, calibrate false positives and false negatives, keep rejected blueprints and failed rollouts, and test committee correlation and verifier gaming. The public file cannot support that analysis because these records are absent.

For release and audit work, APIGen-MT is a concrete example of why a transcript is not a replayable episode. An improved release would bind each row to its blueprint, ground truth, reset/final state, state diff, reward, validator/committee record, attempt and terminal metadata, exact tau-bench/API/policy/database revision, and executable replay instructions. It would also reconcile the final-paper/project API count difference and map public 5k rows to the experimental conditions up to 8k and the complete model mixtures.

The appropriate boundary is: conditionally usable as an SFT transcript resource after access and rights review; useful as a recipe and audit reference; not established as a preference, reward-model, process-supervision, RL/RLVR, or full-environment dataset. A binary success label used for filtering does not by itself make the published rows an RL reward interface, and downstream benchmark performance does not establish data quality.

在 environment_agent_trajectory_data 轨道中，APIGen-MT 首先适合作为构造蓝图使用。builder 可以把 environment context sampling、blueprint generation、executable/judgment validation、reverse recombination、simulated-user rollout、terminal state/output checking、success-only filtering 与 model-facing serialization 分开。这种拆解便于确定哪些模块需要独立测试，以及哪些 metadata 必须随发布一起保留。

对 SFT 与 agent behavioral cloning 而言，gated 5k 文件提供带 policy context、tool schema、human message、call、observation 和 assistant reply 的多轮样本。复用是有条件的：团队必须接受 gated access，审查 CC-BY-NC-4.0、额外 GPT-4 竞争限制与上游权利，固定两个 HF commit 与 file hash，检查逐行 schema，并显式保留单一 train split 与 success-only provenance。论文没有证明仅凭 5k 就能复现任何 xLAM checkpoint。

对 verifier design 而言，论文提供分层清单：调用语法和类型检查、executable environment check、policy unit test、LLM rubric judgment，以及 full-episode state/output predicate。后续工作应公开每层输出，校准 false positive/false negative，保留 rejected blueprint 与 failed rollout，并测试 committee correlation 和 verifier gaming。公开文件缺少这些记录，因此不能支持这类分析。

对 release/audit 工作而言，APIGen-MT 是“transcript 不等于 replayable episode”的具体案例。改进版发布应把每行绑定到 blueprint、ground truth、reset/final state、state diff、reward、validator/committee record、attempt/terminal metadata、精确 tau-bench/API/policy/database revision 与 executable replay instruction；还应解释最终论文/项目页的 API 数量差异，并把公开 5k 行映射到最高 8k 的实验条件和完整模型 mixture。

合适的边界是：在 access 与 rights 审查后，可有条件用作 SFT transcript resource；可作为 recipe 与 audit reference；但没有证据表明它是 preference、reward-model、process-supervision、RL/RLVR 或完整 environment 数据集。构造时用于筛选的二元 success label 本身不会把公开行变成 RL reward interface，下游 benchmark performance 也不能建立数据质量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep two objects separate: the paper's blueprint and verifier record are richer than the public row, which contains only conversations, system, and tools.
  • Keep the release boundary exact: APIGen-MT-5k is gated, CC-BY-NC-4.0, 5,000 success-only rows in one train split; failed Phase-2 trajectories are discarded.
  • Keep the scale and mixture boundary exact: experiments reach 8k APIGen-MT samples, and xLAM training also includes APIGen and other xLAM/ActionStudio data, so 5k is not the full mixture.
  • Keep version drift visible: the final paper reports 5 read and 13 write APIs, while the current project page reports 15 read and 13 write APIs; freeze the HF card/file commits and SHA-256.
  • Before reuse, verify code, environment/reset and replay manifests, blueprint-to-row lineage, verifier calibration, failed attempts, decontamination, mixture mapping, annotation protocol, and license restrictions.

• 必须区分两种对象：论文中的 blueprint/verifier record 比公开行丰富；公开行只有 conversations、system 与 tools。
  • 发布边界必须写准：APIGen-MT-5k 是 gated、采用 CC-BY-NC-4.0 的单一 train split，共 5,000 条 success-only 记录；失败的 Phase-2 轨迹会被丢弃。
  • 规模与 mixture 边界必须写准：实验中的 APIGen-MT 样本最高达到 8k，xLAM 训练还加入 APIGen 和其他 xLAM/ActionStudio data，因此 5k 不是完整训练混合。
  • 版本漂移必须保留：最终论文报告 5 个 read API 与 13 个 write API，当前项目页报告 15 个 read API 与 13 个 write API；应固定 HF card/file commit 和 SHA-256。
  • 复用前仍需核验代码、environment/reset 与 replay manifest、blueprint-to-row lineage、verifier calibration、失败尝试、decontamination、mixture mapping、annotation protocol 和 license restriction。
